td_climate_coupling.temperature_mean: TD temp + TD beta * (max(composed,0)-max(rawTD,0)); no independent-noise mean
td_climate_coupling.temperature_variability: existing monthly anomalies centered and normalized to TD std/100; BIO mean/std use 12 unweighted months
td_climate_coupling.precipitation_mean: clip(TD annualP * existing terrain precipitation_multiplier,100,3200) mm/year
td_climate_coupling.precipitation_variability: existing monthly anomaly scaled to TD CV/100 when all months remain nonnegative; otherwise existing positive seasonal shape retained
td_climate_coupling.independent_noise_role: deterministic monthly phase only; annual climate means come from TD conditions

time.assimilation_epoch: declared synthetic year 1 start at physical t=0 seconds; not a civil date
time.snow_interval_clock: each call uses relative 0..month-duration seconds under declared_interval temperatures; no calendar lookup; physical month follows chronological loop
time.instantaneous_fields: snow_swe_mm, soil_water_mm, lake_depth_m, vegetation_fraction, biomass_carbon_kg_m2: final year end
time.annual_fields: temperature and cover_suitability: TD-conditioned 12-month unweighted BIO mean; Q: final-year volume / 31536000 seconds
time.monthly_fields: monthly snow/soil are month-end stores; rain/runoff are interval totals

assumptions.climate_halo: genuine composed30m native source; checked filter-valid support; no clamping
assumptions.lake_evaporation: not modelled; lakes receive terrestrial runoff only
assumptions.lake_scope: final-year filling from dry; no external inflow supplied
assumptions.vegetation_fraction: existing succession live carbon / declared carrying carbon; actual final-year-end cover
assumptions.snow_adapter: only returned mm stores used; native30m metadata/volumes not used

boundaries.external_inflow_status: unknown; eight-cell land-boundary influence propagated on receiver DAG; imposed exports are separate

units.biomass_carbon_kg_m2: live plant carbon kg C per m2
units.monthly_runoff_volume_m3: m3 per cell per calendar month
units.receiver: row-major cell account ID; -1 explicit outlet

weathering.domain: terrestrial land only; ocean weatherable bedrock and initial mantle are zero

succession.forcing: monthly end-of-month total soil+fast+slow water / 150mm; monthly temperature; zero fire/disturbance hazards
succession.time: final year monthly transient, declared initial canopy; no equilibrium or species claim

limitations: synthetic climate and declared uncalibrated coefficients
cropped land boundary exports and missing inflow remain explicit
generation incision is bounded geometry; no hydraulic erosion or calibrated ecology

time.forcing: Twelve equal intervals per 365-day year at saved world final-year mean inlet Q; local steady-forcing engineering evaluation, not a synchronous seasonal rerun of the world

figures.coverage_meaning: Engineering distributary excavation plus conservative local morphodynamics on same-world TD; prescribed sediment concentration is not upstream erosion. Dark water is native solved wet area; light lake water is saved 90 m water-level projection onto native bed, with unchanged 90 m storage. Fine river lines are computed topology and dashed upstream chain assigns no additional Q.

neighbor_lakes.method: Saved 90 m lake surface=elevation+lake_depth, nearest lake surface projected onto native final bed; support limited to actual 90 m lake mask plus one 90 m cell
neighbor_lakes.storage: Original 90 m storage ledger unchanged; no rerouting or 30 m storage conservation claim
neighbor_lakes.upstream_context: Saved receiver chain before inlet, including low-Q lake carry nodes; dashed line assigns no additional discharge

figures.tidal_state: Explicit initial nearshore/tidal creek construction, prescribed constant sea stage 0 m; no periodic tidal hydrodynamics or emergent platform claim

cartography: Cream paper; vegetation/rock continuous cover tint; snow SWE blend; physical terrain_map_style hillshade, vertical exaggeration 1; no generated visual detail; receiver lines without geometric smoothing; widths enlarged for display only

coverage_status_definitions.complete_in_window: Named field is fully available in the displayed window; not a validation of physical realism
